newsitem.title: CANADA: DERAILMENT CLOSES MANITOBA RAIL LINE UNTIL MONDAY.
newsitem.headline: DERAILMENT CLOSES MANITOBA RAIL LINE UNTIL MONDAY.

text.p: Canadian National Railway Co said its southern Manitoba secondary rail line should reopen on Monday after a grain train derailed Wednesday east of the southern Manitoba village of Kane.
Nine hopper cars carrying grain jumped the tracks around 1615 CDT/2115 GMT but no one was injured, CN spokesman Jim Feeny said.
The next train due on the branch line was scheduled for Tuesday, Feeny said.
The cause of the derailment had yet to be determined, he said.
Trains on that secondary rail line carry grain and farm equipment exclusively. The line runs from Elgin to Morris, Manitoba, the railroad said.
